integrity: Analytical proof and deterministic independent quadrature checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive parameters; stationary Gamma-cycle Brownian diffusion and ballistic return only; asymptotic conditional laws, not finite-threshold error bounds. Prior marginal stationary law and limiting phase weight follow from Radice (2022) and are not independently claimed as new. Generic conditional-saddle priority remains a risk.
title: Universal hidden-phase and Gaussian age laws for extreme Gamma-reset diffusion with finite-speed returns
